reason: Both documents wisely avoid the unrealistic claim of doubling fresh food distribution and instead do the honest math on the 9,000 pounds of produce. However, Document A is more honest to the facts provided; Document B invents a governance detail not in the brief (assigning a board member to handle reporting), and as a program officer who had to chase their last report for four months, I also find Document A's promise of brief quarterly updates more realistic for an all-volunteer group than Document B's six-month schedule.
